value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical smallest triangle-free graph of chromatic number four. The exact zero-forcing polynomial is a natural complete dynamical enumerator (not a narrow parameter slice), and the exhaustive optimum classification yields nineteen symmetry types, variable forcing times, and a connected token-jump geometry. This directly addresses the published motivated program of counting all zero-forcing initial configurations and of comparing propagation times, rather than merely recomputing the scalar forcing number; the exact reconfiguration metric adds network-control flexibility information.
